title: Content of illustrations – what is being depicted?

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines
location.section: Content of illustrations – what is being depicted?

slide_intent: Give illustrations specific people, places and information because generic symbols can flatten a city’s character and obscure its message.
strategic_value: Recognizable Helsinki details and inclusive subjects can connect imagination with local identity.
demonstration: This expanded webpage section compares inclusive people, local cityscapes, unusual stories, sustainability explanations and information graphics, then shows pattern-like illustration applications.
practical_value: Select an illustrative subject that makes Helsinki or the intended information identifiable.

content_islands.name: People and place
content_islands.spec: Compare diverse subjects and recognizable Helsinki settings with generic alternatives.

content_islands.name: Stories and sustainability
content_islands.spec: Show inventive city stories and age-appropriate sustainability imagery.

content_islands.name: Information versus decoration
content_islands.spec: Compare concrete information graphics with abstract symbolic images.

content_islands.name: Pattern applications
content_islands.spec: Finish with campaign/event pattern examples and their uses.

ingredient.name: Illustration subject
ingredient.role: Make Helsinki’s character or information specific and understandable.
ingredient.application: Include recognizable local features and diverse people; choose concrete information over generic sustainability symbolism.
ingredient.scope: Pattern-like illustrations are allowed for campaigns/events and when photos are unsuitable; waves are usually unnecessary in that context.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text explains that information visualization exists to communicate efficiently and comprehensibly, not to decorate.
reference_purposes.Application: The comparisons demonstrate local details, inclusive subjects and explanatory information graphics.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Illustrations should include recognizable Helsinki features; a wave motif is usually unnecessary with pattern-like illustration, not absolutely prohibited.
